Sources & clinical checks

Merck veterinary dose table: SQ 0.2–0.5 mg/kg per dose; IV CRI 1–2 mg/kg/day. These are reference ranges, not an automatic patient-specific dose.

ANSES product information: avoid with GI obstruction, perforation or hemorrhage; renal/hepatic impairment may require adjustment. Review neurologic risk and interacting drugs, including phenothiazines and CNS depressants. This foreign product label is not authorization for a local product or IV admixture.

Confirm diluent, compatibility, stability, aseptic preparation and line/pump management with your local protocol. Bag calculation assumes homogeneous mixing and the stated final volume; bag overfill is not estimated. Changing the fluid rate changes drug delivery.

Local-anesthetic exposure review

Displayed doses are workbook references, not validated species-specific maximum doses. Enter all prior exposure during the clinically relevant interval, including other routes and formulations. Verify the interval with the treating clinician; no elimination or recovery is assumed.

Caution: Combining local anesthetics may cause additive toxicity. Being below each individual reference does not establish a safe combination. Current calculations do not enforce a species-specific maximum. Evidence and approval status →
